why: The reference example of this format, and the only fixture that can be cross-checked against the code that produces it: copied verbatim from `NoodleAgent.run` (src/impress_a/tools/mock_agents.py:81-84). The tool completes, reports a confident designability of 0.91, and hands back a structure with essentially no secondary structure. Nothing about its exit status, its `result`, or its own headline metric says anything is wrong. Only `has_secondary_structure` catches it. This is the Part A failure mode the whole QC layer exists for, manufactured on purpose so the layer is tested at campaign scale.
